title: CALCULATETABLE ( ALL ( Sales ) ) as a filter argument filters with all the rows of Sales
query: EVALUATE CALCULATETABLE ( ROW ( "r", CALCULATE ( COUNTROWS ( Product ), CALCULATETABLE ( ALL ( Sales ) ) ) ), Product[Color] = "Red" )

source.quote: ALL still behaves like a REMOVEFILTERS , but CALCULATETABLE forces the result back
source.supports: inside CALCULATETABLE the rows of ALL ( Sales ) are returned and act as a filter

source.quote: the filter context contains all the columns of the expanded version of Sales
source.supports: a table filter argument filters all the columns of expanded Sales

derivation: CALCULATETABLE returns all 7 Sales rows, ignoring the Red filter. As a filter argument this is the expanded Sales table: it overwrites the color filter and keeps the products that have sales, 1, 2 and 3: 3. Scooter (4) has none.
notes: Compare all-fact-table-is-a-filter-removal-not-a-table, where the bare ALL ( Sales ) gives 4.
